notes.title: Wandering owl realesed!
notes.notes:
We released our new and first game on Steam platform finally.
We had a lot of issues and difficulties on our path to this release.
Some of them are not fixed yet, but we think the game is good enough to release now.
Wandering Owl is our first project as a games developers at LazyGnomes.
We learn every day during our work to bring quality and something special to our games. 
Next step for us is to add Achievements, Collectible cards and other improvements to Wandering Owl.
In two weeks we are going to start creating a plan of development of our new game. And this game will be way better, because we grow with a new talents at our team =)
We’re doing our best for you! Stay tuned!
